description: Rothco’s 3 Color Face Paint Compact is a tactical essential for outdoor activities that require effective camouflage. This compact features 3 distinct colors: black, olive, and brown, designed to blend seamlessly with woodland environments. Whether you’re hunting, engaging in tactical operations, or observing wildlife, this face paint provides superior concealment to keep you hidden from sight. This face paint is also easy to remove with soap and water, making cleanup a breeze. Enhance your outdoor experience with Rothco’s reliable and versatile face paint, designed to meet the needs of enthusiasts and professionals alike.
